# Volta Power Electric

> Licensed residential and commercial electrician (CA C-10 Contractor License #1161104), based in Rosemead, CA, serving Los Angeles County, Orange County, San Bernardino County, Ventura County and the Inland Empire. Services include EV charger installation, SPAN Smart Panel installation, Tesla Powerwall and battery backup, electrical panel upgrades, generator installation, home and ADU rewiring, troubleshooting and repair, interior and landscape lighting, and commercial tenant improvements and maintenance contracts.

Owner-operated by founder Abel Chavira: UEI College certified electrical technician, OSHA 10 certified, SPAN Authorized Installer, and Tesla Certified Installer. Offers 24/7 emergency electrical service; standard hours Monday-Friday 8am-5pm. Phone: (562) 639-0720. Email: abel@voltapowerelectric.com.

Volta Power Electric Inc. is an SCE Charge Ready Home Program Participating Contractor. Southern California Edison's Charge Ready Home Program offers eligible SCE residential customers up to $4,200 toward an electrical panel upgrade with a dedicated Level 2 EV outlet, or up to $1,000 for an EV outlet only. Eligibility is based on household income (under 80% of area median income or enrollment in a qualifying assistance program) or living in a state-designated disadvantaged community. Owning an EV is not required.
